title: NASA: Integrated System for Autonomous and Adaptive Caretaking
support: Robotic inspection combined with vehicle telemetry and coordinated execution.
boundary: The cited ISS obstruction scenario did not include manipulator repair.

title: Buchner et al.: Vision-controlled jetting for composite systems and robots
support: Measured print geometry informs subsequent deposition.
boundary: This is manufacturing evidence, not autonomous habitat repair validation.

title: Tan et al.: Tactile sensory coding and learning with bio-inspired optoelectronic spiking afferent nerves
support: Pressure sensing, optical spike encoding and photomemristor integration.
boundary: No validation of this proposed deforming robot skin or grip controller.

title: Du et al.: Reservoir computing using dynamic memristors for temporal information processing
support: Experimental material dynamics used for temporal processing.
boundary: Software readout and specific devices; not a universal material law.

title: Follmer et al.: inFORM - Dynamic Physical Affordances and Constraints through Shape and Object Actuation
support: Shape displays can provide changing constraints and actuate objects.
boundary: The work does not qualify load-bearing tooling or deposited fixtures.

title: Perez et al.: Multipurpose silicon photonics signal processor core
support: Experimental programmable waveguide routing and linear transformations.
boundary: No validation of the PM compiler or its pinion mapping.

title: Perez-Lopez et al.: Multipurpose self-configuration of programmable photonic circuits
support: Measured feedback used for characterization, routing and configuration.
boundary: Component experiments do not guarantee convergence for arbitrary requested transforms.

title: NASA: Robot Team Builds High-Performance Digital Structure
support: Ground demonstration of coordinated autonomous structural block assembly.
boundary: This does not establish deployed space construction or construction-seed semantics.

title: Suzuki et al.: RoomShift - Room-scale Dynamic Haptics for VR with Furniture-moving Swarm Robots
support: Demonstrated furniture-moving robots as physical VR proxies.
boundary: Not a guarantee of arbitrary room layouts or unrestricted human contact.

title: HapticBots: Distributed Encountered-type Haptics for VR with Multiple Shape-changing Mobile Robots
support: Research prototype with moving and shape-changing haptic proxies.
boundary: Does not validate PM mapping, readiness or cross-room replay contracts.

title: Optimizing multi-user indoor sound communications with acoustic reconfigurable metasurfaces (2024)
support: Demonstrated room-channel shaping with tunable resonators.
boundary: Does not validate this adaptive occupied-room architecture.

title: Burger et al., A mobile robotic chemist, Nature (2020)
support: Autonomous operation across defined laboratory workstations.
boundary: Does not establish arbitrary laboratory reconfiguration.

title: OpenUSD 25.11: Sdf Scene Description Foundations
support: Layered scene description and explicit composition.
boundary: Does not itself guarantee network convergence or intent preservation.

title: Chen and Shea, An Autonomous Programmable Actuator and Shape Reconfigurable Structures Using Bistability and Shape Memory Polymers
support: Programmed thermal deployment and reconfigurable structures.
boundary: Does not establish this repeated feedback-trimming architecture.

title: NASA Jet Propulsion Laboratory: NeBula
support: Multi-robot autonomy with intermittent mesh communication.
boundary: Does not establish autonomous repair under arbitrary partitions.

title: Cambridge: Staffordshire Bridges long-term monitoring
support: Installed fibre sensors, continuous acquisition and digital-twin analysis on real bridges.
boundary: Does not demonstrate distributed material-memory modules or autonomous structural diagnosis.

title: WUR: Digital Twin controls cucumber cultivation
support: A reported cultivation trial links models and sensors to climate, irrigation and staff pruning instructions.
boundary: Does not demonstrate the proposed equipment-repair scheduler or autonomous handling of every biological disturbance.

title: Wang et al.: Structured fabrics with tunable mechanical properties
support: Experiments demonstrate reversible pressure-controlled stiffening of interlocking structured fabrics.
boundary: Does not qualify a finished garment, medical application, impact protection or unrestricted user contact.

title: NASA: Space-station printer builds a ratchet wrench
support: An uplinked design was manufactured in orbit during a technology demonstration.
boundary: The reported wrench was reserved for ground testing; this was not autonomous planetary fixture qualification.

title: Gongora et al.: A Bayesian experimental autonomous researcher
support: Automated experiments and Bayesian optimization explored a defined mechanical design family.
boundary: Does not establish unrestricted machine redesign, global optimality or qualification for arbitrary deployed tasks.

title: Feldmann et al.: Integrated photonic tensor core
support: Demonstrates photonic in-memory convolution using phase-change arrays and optical frequency combs.
boundary: Does not establish the proposed PM controller, arbitrary transforms or universal total-system efficiency advantages.
